title: Elicitation Kinetics of Phenolic Antioxidants & Solanine Glycoalkaloids via UV-B Irradiance
description: Doctoral research examining UVR8 photoreceptor activation, Phenylalanine Ammonia-Lyase (PAL, EC 4.3.1.24) kinetics, and phenolic antioxidant synthesis under pulsed UV-B lighting.
image_caption: Narrowband UV-B (285nm) LED illumination module deployed for pre-harvest phytochemical elicitation.
overview: Targeted UV-B radiation (280-315nm) activates the UVR8 dimeric photoreceptor, triggering COP1 signaling and up-regulating Phenylalanine Ammonia-Lyase (PAL, EC 4.3.1.24), the entry enzyme of the phenylpropanoid pathway. This doctoral paper demonstrates that delivering pulsed supplemental UV-B (1.5 W/m² for 45 minutes daily over 7 days pre-harvest) induces a +64% increase in lycopene and total flavonoid content without causing photosynthetic photo-inhibition or yield loss.

climate_strategy.strategy: Install narrow-spectrum UV-B LEDs (290nm). Program pulsed irradiation cycles during peak daytime hours when PAR > 400 µmol/m²/s to allow active DNA repair via photolyase enzymes.

fertigation.intro: Micronutrient cofactors for secondary metabolite biosynthesis.
